exposure: Free maternal healthcare laws and policies
Out-of-pocket expenditures for maternal healthcare services
outcome: Prevalence of out-of-pocket expenditures for maternal healthcare services
Association between socio-demographic factors and out-of-pocket expenditures
cohort: Women aged 15-49 years who used a component service or their accompanying persons, as well as facility chief financial officers or billing administrators
finding: Despite the existence of free care laws, women in Argentina, Ghana, and India incurred both direct and indirect costs for maternal healthcare services designated as free.
